Caterpillars reared from trees in primary and secondary forest at Wanang

Source: R/data.R
wanang_caterpillars.Rd

Real field data: Lepidoptera larvae collected from the foliage of trees in a primary and a secondary forest plot in the Wanang Conservation Area, Madang Province, Papua New Guinea, between 2003 and 2009, and reared to adults where possible by the New Guinea Binatang Research Centre (Butterill and Redmond 2023). Each plot has five sampling units (WP1-WP5 in primary and WS1-WS5 in secondary forest). Counts are the number of individuals of each morphospecies reared from each host plant species. Taxa are morphospecies codes identified to different ranks (species, genus, family or order), so treat them as morphospecies, not as named species. The host plant makes the data suited to species-overlap diagrams (plot_venn()) and host-use comparisons.

Usage

wanang_caterpillars

Format

A tibble with one row per sampling unit, host plant and morphospecies, and eight columns:

site

Forest type, "primary" or "secondary".

plot

Sampling unit, "WP1"-"WP5" and "WS1"-"WS5".

host

Host plant species (NA when not recorded).

species

Morphospecies code (GBIF taxonID).

scientific_name

Most precise name given for the morphospecies.

rank

Rank of scientific_name.

family

Lepidoptera family (NA when only identified to order).

abundance

Number of individuals.

Source

Butterill, P. and Redmond, C. (2023). Plot-based sampling and rearing of adult lepidoptera from lowland rainforest in Wanang, Papua New Guinea. Version 1.1. New Guinea Binatang Research Centre. Occurrence dataset, GBIF. doi:10.15468/7e96ht , released under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): cite this source when you use the data. Built from all 9,354 GBIF occurrence records by data-raw/wanang_caterpillars.R.

Examples

wanang_caterpillars
#> # A tibble: 3,504 x 8
#>    site    plot  host  species scientific_name            rank  family abundance
#>    <chr>   <chr> <chr> <chr>   <chr>                      <chr> <chr>      <int>
#>  1 primary WP1   NA    TORT151 Nolidae                    fami~ Nolid~         9
#>  2 primary WP1   NA    TORT230 Tortricidae                fami~ Tortr~         4
#>  3 primary WP1   NA    CHOR001 Brenthia Clemens, 1860     genus Chore~         2
#>  4 primary WP1   NA    TORT051 Homona phanaea Meyrick, 1~ spec~ Tortr~         2
#>  5 primary WP1   NA    TORT234 Tortricidae                fami~ Tortr~         2
#>  6 primary WP1   NA    CHOR006 Choreutidae                fami~ Chore~         1
#>  7 primary WP1   NA    CRAM134 Crambidae                  fami~ Cramb~         1
#>  8 primary WP1   NA    ELAC001 Elachistidae               fami~ Elach~         1
#>  9 primary WP1   NA    GELE013 Gelechiidae                fami~ Gelec~         1
#> 10 primary WP1   NA    GEOM034 Symmacra solidaria ochrea~ subs~ Geome~         1
#> # i 3,494 more rows
div_hill(wanang_caterpillars, site = plot, q = 0:2) |> head()
